title: 出师表
classical: 先帝创业未半而中道崩殂，今天下三分，益州疲弊，此诚危急存亡之秋也。
old_english: The great cause of the first emperor was not half completed and died in the middle. Now the world is divided into three countries, the population of Yizhou is scarce, this is indeed a time of national crisis.

title: 出师表
classical: 然侍卫之臣不懈于内，忠志之士忘身于外者，盖追先帝之殊遇，欲报之于陛下也。

reason: 「内」误作 in the DPRK（朝鲜）属严重误译 +「忠志之士」窄化为 generals +「侍卫之臣」误作 close officials

title: 出师表

title: 出师表

title: 廉颇蔺相如列传
classical: 秦王怒，不许。
old_english: King of Qin got angry and refused.
new_english: The King of Qin got angry and refused.
reason: 专名规范化（秦王／赵王统一为 the King of + 国名）

title: 廉颇蔺相如列传
classical: 于是相如前进缻，因跪请秦王。
old_english: Then Xiangru delivered the tile to the king and knelt down, begging him to play it.
new_english: Then Xiangru stepped forward to offer the basin, and kneeling begged the King of Qin to play it.
reason: 「跪请秦王」的宾语 the King of Qin 被简化为 him，专名丢失

title: 廉颇蔺相如列传
classical: 既罢归国，以相如功大，拜为上卿，位在廉颇之右。
old_english: After the Mianchi meeting, King Zhao returned to his country, and he believed that Lian Xiangru had made great contributions, so he appointed him as the Prime Minister, whose status was higher than Lian Po.
new_english: When the meeting was over and he returned to his state, because Xiangru's merit was great the King of Zhao appointed him a High Minister, with rank above Lian Po.
reason: 「蔺相如」误作 Lian Xiangru（把廉颇的姓拼上）+「上卿」误作 Prime Minister +「以」误作 believed that

title: 廉颇蔺相如列传
classical: 蔺相如固止之，曰：“公之视廉将军孰与秦王？
old_english: Lian Xiangru resolutely retained them, saying: Who do you think is more powerful between General Lian and King Qin?
new_english: Lin Xiangru firmly held them back, saying: 'In your judgment, how does General Lian compare with the King of Qin?'
reason: 「蔺相如」误作 Lian Xiangru，与「廉将军」同姓化

title: 廉颇蔺相如列传
classical: 廉颇闻之，肉袒负荆，因宾客至蔺相如门谢罪。
old_english: Hearing these words, Lian Po took off his coat, 露出上身, carried a wicker stick, and led by a guest, came to Lin Xiangru's door to apologize.
new_english: Hearing this, Lian Po bared his shoulders and back, carried bramble thorns on his back, and led by one of his retainers came to Lin Xiangru's gate to beg pardon.
reason: 英文句中残留中文「露出上身」；「负荆」误作 wicker stick（柳条）；「谢罪」弱化为 apologize

title: 廉颇蔺相如列传
classical: 卒相与欢，为刎颈之交。
old_english: In the end they became friends again, neck-cutting friends.
new_english: In the end they were reconciled and became friends sworn to die for each other.
reason: 「刎颈之交」逐字直译为 neck-cutting friends，整体义丢失
